faq_heading: Homes near Cindrich Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Cindrich Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Cindrich Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It matches the school’s name in the listing text. A home near Cindrich Elementary whose listing doesn’t mention it won’t appear.

faq.q: How much do homes near Cindrich Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 31 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,270,000, condos $400,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Cindrich Elementary?
faq.a: For the 31 homes that sold within 1 km of Cindrich Elementary, the median time on the market was 18 days and the median sale was 95.8% of list; 6% sold above list.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Cindrich Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Creekside Elementary (0.8 km east), Queen Elizabeth Secondary (0.9 km north) and Betty Huff Elementary (1.0 km north-west).

Cindrich Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 13455 90 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Cindrich Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Cindrich Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Cindrich Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Cindrich Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 31 homes sold within 1 km of Cindrich Elementary: 19 houses, 4 townhomes and 8 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,270,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Cindrich Elementary

33 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Cindrich Elementary in a straight line (18 elementary, 12 secondary, 3 other; 4 independent). The closest is Creekside Elementary, 0.8 km away, and the farthest on this list is Cedar Hills Elementary, 2.7 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Queen Elizabeth Secondary (0.9 km); the nearest independent school is Sikh Academy (1.5 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Simon Cunningham Elementary (1.4 km). Other elementary schools close by: Creekside Elementary (0.8 km east), Betty Huff Elementary (1.0 km north-west), David Brankin Elementary (1.3 km west), Simon Cunningham Elementary (1.4 km north-east), A H P Matthew Elementary (1.4 km north). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Creekside Elementary, 0.8 km east of Cindrich Elementary.
